prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Your Pet is Arriving!", "We are preparing your companion desktop pet."]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Let's make sure your desktop pet appears correctly on your screen.", "Verify Display Permissions"]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to pick a standard pet or generate a custom friend.", "Standard vs Custom Pet"]
4: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "This usually takes about 2-3 minutes. You can minimize this window safely."]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, move them, or send them to sleep.", "Right-click for controls | Drag to move | Double-click to talk"]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast for best 3D pet generation results.", "Avoid blurry images or photos with multiple animals."]
7: ["Sign In to Sync Your Pets", "Your account keeps your custom pets safe across re-installs and updates.", "Always use the same login method to restore your active pets."]
8: ["Select Your Pet Experience", "Choose how you want to start your journey."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new pet a name to finalize your adoption!", "Pet Name"]
